task.name: pick_mouse_basket
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the mouse from the tray and place it in the basket.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the mouse on the tray.
2. Grasp the mouse with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the basket.
4. Release the gripper to place the mouse into the basket.
